sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Fujioka the Info Broker (情報屋の藤岡) is a former member of the Memorial Mob, who has now turned to selling information, yet didn't fully abandon his old habit of robbing corpses of their possessions.
If met in Ashina Castle, he'll employ the help of Wolf to get rid of the Ashina Soldiers who are chasing him.
Once he moves to the Dilapidated Temple, he'll be willing to trade wares and insights with Sekiro.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Ashina Castle: in the dead end beneath the alley to the right of General Kuranosuke Matsumoto.
- Dilapidated Temple: to the side of the path that leads to Hanbei.

sections.heading: Ashina Castle (Ashina Castle)
sections.text: (Optional) Grapple onto the rooftops to the right just past the Sculptor's Idol and kill the Ashina Soldiers nearby, then talk to Fujioka to receive the Nightjar Beacon Memo.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Dilapidated Temple )
sections.text: After saving him or once Genichiro Ashina is defeated, Fujioka will now be found to the left of the temple coming from the Sculptor's Idol and will act as a merchant.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace (Fountainhead Palace)
sections.text:
Upon defeating the Corrupted Monk, the Dragon's Tally Board she drops will unlock new
items at every merchant.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Outskirts Wall - Stairway )
sections.text: Complete Anayama's questline (see his page for more in-depth info) to acquire the Promissory Note, which will discount by 10% the cost of every item sold by merchants.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Purchasing the Gourd Seed from the Info Broker is a necessary step to unlock the "Ultimate Healing Gourd" trophy.
- He's the only merchant to sell an infinite supply of Pacifying Agents and Ungo's Sugars.
- Fujioka also sells an unlimited quantity of Antidote Powder like the Toxic Memorial Mob but 20 Sen cheaper, while also being faster to reach.
- Can't be infected with Dragonrot while he's in Ashina Castle.
